units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:8">B. Bath. X, 8</cite> <he>לאחר ח׳ שטרות</he> after the deeds were signed.

senses.gloss: (ברכות) ח׳ the formula with which a prayer closes, concluding benediction (‘Blessed be thou, O Lord. who &c.’).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 12a:15">Ber. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>הכל הולך אחר ח׳ ב׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. only <he>הח׳</he>) the concluding formula decides the appropriateness of a prayer.
<cite ref="Berakhot 12a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>או אחר ח׳ ב׳ אזלינן</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="H01888"><he>חתימה</he></cite>) or do we go by the concluding phrase?—Pl. <he>חִיתּוּמִין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:23">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אחר חִיתּוּמֵיהֶן</he> according to their conclusions; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:23">ib.</cite> <he>חוֹתְמוֹתֵיהֶן</he>, v. <cite ref="H00498"><he>חוֹתָם</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:3:2">Y.
